data.one_liner: Flutter package offering ~1000 Iconsax icons in Bold, Bulk and Outline styles.
data.what_it_does: Provides a collection of Iconsax icons as ready‑to‑use IconData constants. You can import the package and use the icons directly in Flutter widgets. Supports three visual styles without additional assets.
use_when: You need a large set of ready‑made icons for a Flutter UI
You prefer a single‑dependency solution for Iconsax icons
You want to avoid loading custom fonts manually
avoid_when: You require icons from other libraries or custom SVG assets
You need runtime icon loading or theming beyond the provided styles
strengths: Simple API – just import and use
weaknesses: No built‑in theming or color variants beyond IconData

alternatives.name: font_awesome_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a widely used icon set with many styles and community support
